content:
Here's a draft LinkedIn post for you:

---

🎉 Excited to share some personal news: I've officially joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**!

Having worked with CDS Hooks since 2017, it's an incredible honor to now help steer the future of a standard I've believed in for so long. CDS Hooks has come a long way in enabling real-time, context-aware clinical decision support across healthcare systems — and there's still so much potential ahead. I'm looking forward to collaborating with the community to keep moving the standard forward.

A couple of asks for the community 👇

✅ **Already using CDS Hooks?** Please add your implementation to the public availability list so we can better understand adoption and showcase the ecosystem:
👉 https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

🛠️ **Not using CDS Hooks yet but curious?** I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you design, implement, and integrate CDS Hooks into your workflows. Feel free to reach out — I'd love to chat.

Here's to the next chapter of CDS Hooks 🚀

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #Interoperability #ClinicalDecisionSupport #FHIR #DigitalHealth

---

Want me to adjust the tone (more formal, more casual), shorten it, or tailor it toward a specific audience like vendors, providers, or developers?
